breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the instruction to set the end slopes to zero for a simply supported beam was incorrect. It removed this erroneous condition and replaced it with the correct physical boundary condition: 'end slopes free to rotate'. This matches the intent of the ground truth, which removed the incorrect sentence entirely.
